content2.content: For desktop and web, you need to handle mouse hovers and keyboard shortcuts.

content4.content: Detects when the mouse enters, exits, or hovers over a widget.

content5.content:
MouseRegion(
  onEnter: (_) => setState(() => _hovering = true),
  onExit: (_) => setState(() => _hovering = false),
  cursor: SystemMouseCursors.click,
  child: Container(color: _hovering ? Colors.blue : Colors.grey),
)
